name: Robotics
description:
Introduction and basic concepts of robotics that allow application of  a planned trajectory on the hardware of a manipulator system. The lecture covers the description of the robot geometry and conversions between the workspace of the robot and the motions of the robot joints, the dynamic analysis of the robot motion. This analysis is used to derive the structure and parameters of the control to provide position- and force-control for manipulation tasks.


Any questions, please contat Andrei Costinescu, M.Sc. (andrei.costinescu@tum.de).
